entities.name: Our Lady of Solitude Cathedral, Acapulco
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Our Lady of Solitude Cathedral is the main Catholic church of the city of Acapulco, Guerrero, Mexico, located in the center of the city in front of the Álvarez Square. It has been the episcopal seat of the Archdiocese of Acapulco since 1958.
